mapper.select: SELECT CS.ID AS COURSE_STUDENT_ID , U.NAME AS STUDENT_NAME , AS NAME_SUFFIX , CC.OPINION FROM COURSE_STUDENT CS INNER JOIN "USER" U ON CS.USER_ID = U.ID LEFT JOIN COURSE_CONSULT CC ON CC.COURSE_STUDENT_ID = CS.ID WHERE CS.COURSE_ID = #{_parameter} AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY U.NAME ASC , CS.ID ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM COURSE_STUDENT CS INNER JOIN "USER" U ON CS.USER_ID = U.ID WHERE CS.ID = #{courseStudentId} AND CS.COURSE_ID = #{courseId} AND U.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT CS.ID AS COURSE_STUDENT_ID , C."NO" AS COURSE_NO , C.COURSE_NAME , TO_CHAR(C.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS START_DATE , TO_CHAR(C.END_DATED, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_DATE , U.NAME AS STUDENT_NAME , AS NAME_SUFFIX , CC.GENDER
, CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(CC.CONTACT, '^[0-9a-f]+$') AND MOD(LENGTH(CC.CONTACT), 32) = 0 THEN AES_DECRYPTION(CC.CONTACT) ELSE CC.CONTACT END AS CONTACT FROM COURSE_STUDENT CS INNER JOIN COURSE C ON CS.COURSE_ID = C.ID INNER JOIN "USER" U ON CS.USER_ID = U.ID LEFT JOIN COURSE_CONSULT CC ON CC.COURSE_STUDENT_ID = CS.ID WHERE CS.ID = #{_parameter}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COURSE_CONSULT ( COURSE_STUDENT_ID , GENDER , CONTACT ) VALUES ( #{courseStudentId} , #{gender} , AES_ENCRYPTION(#{contact}) )
mapper.select: SELECT CC.CAPABILITY_START_LEVEL , CC.CAPABILITY_START_DESC , CC.CAPABILITY_MID_LEVEL , CC.CAPABILITY_MID_DESC , CC.CAPABILITY_END_LEVEL , CC.CAPABILITY_END_DESC FROM COURSE_CONSULT CC WHERE CC.COURSE_STUDENT_ID = #{_parameter}

SELECT TS.ID AS TEST_SET_ID , TS.SET_NAME , TS.TEST_TYPE , TP.TOTAL_POINT , SA.SCORE , SA.PENDING_COUNT FROM COURSE_STUDENT CS INNER JOIN TEST_SET TS ON TS.COURSE_ID = CS.COURSE_ID INNER JOIN (SELECT TST.TEST_SET_ID , SUM(NVL(T.POINT_ALLOC, 0)) AS TOTAL_POINT FROM TEST_SET_TESTS TST INNER JOIN TESTS T ON TST.TEST_ID = T.ID WHERE T.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY TST.TEST_SET_ID) TP ON TP.TEST_SET_ID = TS.ID LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT TA.COURSE_STUDENT_ID , TA.TEST_SET_ID , AS SCORE , AS PENDING_COUNT FROM TEST_ANSWERS TA INNER JOIN TESTS T ON TA.TEST_ID = T.ID WHERE T.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY TA.COURSE_STUDENT_ID , TA.TEST_SET_ID) SA ON SA.COURSE_STUDENT_ID = CS.USER_ID AND SA.TEST_SET_ID = TS.ID WHERE CS.ID = #{_parameter} ORDER BY TS.ID ASC

SELECT ROUND(AVG(SA.SCORE * 100 / TP.TOTAL_POINT), 1) AS AVG_SCORE FROM COURSE_STUDENT CS INNER JOIN TEST_SET TS ON TS.COURSE_ID = CS.COURSE_ID INNER JOIN (SELECT TST.TEST_SET_ID , SUM(NVL(T.POINT_ALLOC, 0)) AS TOTAL_POINT FROM TEST_SET_TESTS TST INNER JOIN TESTS T ON TST.TEST_ID = T.ID WHERE T.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY TST.TEST_SET_ID) TP ON TP.TEST_SET_ID = TS.ID INNER JOIN (SELECT TA.COURSE_STUDENT_ID , TA.TEST_SET_ID , AS SCORE , AS PENDING_COUNT FROM TEST_ANSWERS TA INNER JOIN TESTS T ON TA.TEST_ID = T.ID WHERE T.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY TA.COURSE_STUDENT_ID , TA.TEST_SET_ID) SA ON SA.COURSE_STUDENT_ID = CS.USER_ID AND SA.TEST_SET_ID = TS.ID WHERE CS.ID = #{_parameter} AND SA.PENDING_COUNT = 0 AND TP.TOTAL_POINT > 0

SELECT CCD.ID , TO_CHAR(CCD.CONSULT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CONSULT_DATE , CCD.CONSULT_TYPE , CCD.CONSULT_DESC FROM COURSE_CONSULT_DATA CCD WHERE CCD.COURSE_STUDENT_ID = #{_parameter} ORDER BY CCD.CONSULT_DATE ASC , CCD.ID ASC
